connects_to.relationship: memory test equipment for Micron test sites

contracts.signal: Correction filing for the semiconductor test equipment supply contract with Micron Memory Malaysia SDN. BHD. (first disclosed 04-14-2026): all products were delivered by 09-04-2026, but delivery-schedule delays pushed out the payment date, so the contract end date moves from 10-02-2026 to 11-06-2026. Amount USD 15,392,000 = KRW 22,863,276,800 at the Hana Bank rate of KRW 1,485.40/USD on 04-13-2026, 14.37% of 2025 consolidated revenue (KRW 159,128,398,402); non-conditional, own production, supply region Malaysia, order received 04-13-2026; payment 90% within 60 days of shipment and 10% within 60 days of approval. Micron is listed as having performed similar contracts with Techwing in the past three years.
contracts.units: semiconductor test equipment; Malaysia; 04-13-2026 to 11-06-2026 (was 10-02-2026); fully delivered 09-04-2026
